content: {"episode_id":"ep-05117","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration of the CO-50 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is requested based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes."}
